ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 10

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 32

13. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 19

14. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

19. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 65

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

21. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

22. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 75
   D. 30

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
